items.text:
This game had me hooked from the start. Ostranauts is what I like to call an iceberg onion kind of game. You can see the surface level gameplay but as the layers peel back you realize that there are levels deeper to explore. It doesn’t hold your hand, it wants you to explore its depths. Something as mundane as watching TV could be beneficial in many ways. Sure it’s a little rough around the edges, could use some QoL improvements (1x time after task completion would be nice) as many games in EA are. I’ve barely scratched the surface and can’t wait to explore more. 
 Allow me to regale you with the sequence of events that led me to write my first review ever:

I was finishing up a wreck and look over at the time, 1:15am. Ok, I’ll finish hauling my loot to the airlock and then I’ll pick back up tomorrow. Outside the ship are cargo nets on either side with boxes in them and earlier I had noticed on one side there is a mass of “meat”. I didn’t realize until I was making the last trip that the Arby’s monster had been growing towards my ship. Crap, I need to get this loot into my ship now or I’ll forget tomorrow and get eaten. I should’ve just stopped there but I pressed on, got everything aboard and left, narrowly avoiding it attaching to my ship. Now I’m flying back to the station and saying “ok I’m just going to land and call it a night” when I notice my oxygen levels are at abnormally high. I find that an oxygen canister I took off the meat ship has spontaneously burst and has more than just oxygen coming out. Rush it outside the ship and destroy it. Come back in and start venting all the air out of sheer panic because WHO KNOWS HOW THE ARBY’s MONSTER PROPAGATES. Then I see that my ship batteries are about to die, but I have a spare so I go to install it when something hits my ship and knocks me over. The Arby’s monster has come…… this is the end……they have the meat.

Oh never mind, it’s just a pirate casually walking into my ship to rummage through my tools for a hacksaw. My guy who is frail and unfit but decent with melee decides to take a chance while they’re distracted. Grabbing a rare wooden bat I found and hoping that my guy is good enough to get the first hit in, let alone survive the fight, he takes a swing. The pirate takes a crushing blow to the chest and collapses on the spot, dying very quickly on the floor of my ship. First combat I’ve done in game, over in one hit. I look over at the time and it’s now 2:30. I had to stop myself from continuing investigating the person who just attacked me and their ship. Also I have to remember that I may still be hurtling towards the station while connected to their ship, which means I have little time to search. I had the option to try and talk to them but considering their actions, their attitude towards me, and the aforementioned trauma, surprise violence was the better option 😅
items.text_zh:
这款游戏从一开始就让我欲罢不能。Ostranauts 是我喜欢称之为冰山洋葱式的那种游戏。你能看到表层玩法，但随着层层剥开，你会意识到还有更深层次等待探索。它不会手把手教你，它想让你去探索它的深处。像看电视这样平凡的事情也可能在很多方面带来好处。当然，它有点粗糙，可以做一些生活质量改进（任务完成后1倍时间会不错），就像许多抢先体验游戏一样。我几乎还没触及表面，已经迫不及待想探索更多了。
 请允许我向你讲述导致我写下人生第一篇评测的一系列事件：

我当时正在完成一艘残骸的搜刮，看了一眼时间，凌晨1:15。好吧，我会把战利品拖到气闸，然后明天再继续。飞船外面两侧都有货网，里面装着箱子，之前我注意到一侧有一团“肉”。直到我最后一趟搬运时，我才意识到那个 Arby's 怪物一直在朝我的飞船生长。糟糕，我现在必须把这些战利品弄进飞船，否则明天我就会忘记，然后被吃掉。我本该就此停下，但我还是继续了，把所有东西都弄上船然后离开，勉强避开了它附着到我的飞船上。现在我正飞回空间站，说着“好吧，我就降落然后收工睡觉”，这时我注意到我的氧气水平异常地高。我发现我从那艘肉船上拿的一个氧气罐自发爆裂了，而且喷出来的不只是氧气。赶紧把它扔到飞船外面并摧毁它。回到船里，因为纯粹的恐慌开始把所有的空气排出去，因为谁知道那个 Arby's 怪物是怎么传播的。然后我看到我的飞船电池快没电了，但我有一个备用的，于是我去安装它，这时有什么东西撞上了我的飞船，把我撞倒了。Arby's 怪物来了……这就是末日……它们有肉了。

哦，等等，没事，只是一个海盗随意走进我的飞船，翻找我的工具想找一把钢锯。我那个虚弱、体能差但近战还行的角色决定趁他们分心时赌一把。抓起我找到的一根稀有木棒，希望我的角色足够强，能打出第一击，更别说活过这场战斗了，他挥出一棒。海盗胸口遭到毁灭性打击，当场倒下，很快死在我飞船的地板上。这是我游戏里的第一次战斗，一击就结束了。我看了看时间，现在已经是2:30了。我不得不阻止自己继续调查那个刚刚袭击我的人以及他们的飞船。而且我还得记住，我可能仍然连着他们的飞船朝空间站飞驰，这意味着我搜索的时间很少。我本来可以选择尝试和他们交谈，但考虑到他们的行为、他们对我的态度，以及前述的创伤，出其不意的暴力是更好的选择😅
